name: SHINE Wire
old_description: Specializing in Cable Assemblies, Wire Harnessing, and Electro-Mechanical Assemblies since 1984. SHINE offers a unique blend of engineering resources, account management, and an approved global supply chain. Supported by our ISO:9001:2015 and IPC620 certifications with TUV Rhineland of North America, SHINE is a reliable and cost-effective extension to your manufacturing operation.
about:
SHINE Wire was founded in 1984 in Adams, Massachusetts. The company operates from a manufacturing center at 25 Print Works Drive and specializes in cable assemblies, wire harnesses, and electro-mechanical assemblies.

Its core services include custom cable assembly, wire harnessing, electro-mechanical assembly (box build), lead wire assembly, cordsets, wire and cable processing, engineering support for new product introduction and design for manufacturing, and testing for performance, safety, and compliance. The shop performs certified soldering and crimping, crimp height verification, crimp pull testing, hipot testing, and computerized testing, supported by tooling calibration, machine maintenance, and statistical process control reporting.

SHINE serves medical device manufacturers such as Smith Medical, along with other electronics and industrial customers requiring UL/CSA-compliant cordsets and RoHS-compliant assemblies. The company holds a UL Recognized Registration (E111307) and CSA recognition, and its products meet IPC/WHMA-A-620 standards.

The company emphasizes a blend of engineering resources, account management, and a vetted global supply chain, positioning itself as a quality-driven contract manufacturer. SHINE is a member of the Wire Harness Manufacturers Association and contributed to the development of the IPC-620 standard, reflecting its commitment to industry standards.
